The Food Safety & Standards Authority of India ( FSSAI) is impleaded as a respondent in PIL No. 03/20167 and PIL No. 01/2012.

sentences.text: Copies of the paper books be supplied to them by the Registry/ the learned counsel for the State.

2. The report of Dr. Lalitha R. Gowda and Shri Shailender Kumar, dated 03.07.2017,
submitted on behalf of FSSAI is taken on record.
Copies of the same have been given to the learned counsel for the State as well as to the learned Amicus Curiae.
3. On going through the report, we find that there are various deficiencies which need to be addressed immediately.

sentences.text: The State shall provide adequate answers to the deficiencies pointed out in the said report before the next date of hearing.
4. One of the major concerns in these PILs is that there is no Commissioner of Food Safety, which is the requirement under Section 30 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.

We direct the Commissioner-Secretary, Health, to be present on the next date of hearing to explain as to why no steps have been taken for creating the post of Commissioner, Food Safety and for appointing a person to that post in spite of clear directions given in our previous order dated 23.5.2017, in paragraph 4 thereof.
5. The report submitted by the learned counsel for the Services Selection Board, is taken on record.

6. Re-notify on 17.07.2017.
 (Ali Mohammad Magrey) (Badar Durrez Ahmed)
 Judge Chief Justice Srinagar 10. 07.2017
